scope: Reproduction specifications only; no application executions claimed.

cases.name: Python315Only
cases.given: No .venv or override; ordinary regular x64 3.15.0 on trusted PATH, pypdf absent
cases.expected: Setup selects 3.15, creates local venv, then original PDF processing succeeds. No downgrade or global pip.

cases.name: UnsignedDirectSetup
cases.given: Internet-marked actual setup/helpers, RemoteSigned child, direct ps1 command
cases.expected: Blocked before entry; no claimed Python run; real negative control.

cases.name: UnsignedSetupBat
cases.given: Same marked extracted package and policy, invoke new setup BAT from System32
cases.expected: Setup succeeds under process-scoped child policy; markings/persistent scopes preserved.

cases.name: EmittedActionRoundTrip
cases.given: Capture application Action for missing package on 3.15; execute exact command under RemoteSigned
cases.expected: Action reaches setup and makes original operation succeed; path quoting tested.

cases.name: StaleVenvAfterUpgrade
cases.given: PATH now 3.15; authoritative .venv points at an unavailable/rejected old runtime
cases.expected: Failure identifies actual venv; no silent fallback; explicit repair action preserves backup and selects usable 3.15 base.

cases.name: OlderSecurityPatch
cases.expected: Observed 3.14.2 and current security floor shown; no ambiguous no-Python or unsupported-3.15 wording.

cases.name: UnknownFutureMinor
cases.expected: Unsupported/not-yet-validated distinction; not labeled unsafe or a failed PDF run.

cases.name: ForwardedLauncherFlag
cases.given: py listing returns Unknown option -0; ordinary trusted Python315 exists
cases.expected: Optional diagnostic retained; actual valid direct candidate selected.
